decisions.reason: Polymer concrete drain housings build directly on the firm's core drainage housing engineering, so it can readily learn from market feedback and refine the line.
Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's central competence and strategic direction, giving it high absorptive capacity to keep improving the line.
As the flagship designer shower drain, it combines proven drainage technology with the firm's design focus and remains central to its direction.
The sloped shower element complements the firm's floor-level and waterproofing know-how and fits its move toward integrated systems, though it lies somewhat further from its metal-fabrication base.
The backflow-protected basement drain applies the firm's established drainage and sealing expertise to a related segment where it can interpret results and improve the product.
